description: Fresh non-member control for the contamination check: question/gold-SQL pairs authored 2026-10-18 over BIRD dev's own seven shippable databases, deliberately in BIRD's style and length band. These strings did not exist before this date and cannot be in any pretraining corpus. Every sql is executed against the named dev_databases/<db_id>/<db_id>.sqlite by bench.contamination and must return rows; a pair whose sql fails is a broken control, not a result.

pairs.name: fresh-000
pairs.question: How many superheroes are published by DC Comics?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics')

pairs.name: fresh-001
pairs.question: What is the height of the superhero named A-Bomb?
pairs.sql: SELECT height_cm FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'

pairs.name: fresh-002
pairs.question: List the names of the female superheroes whose publisher is Marvel Comics, ordered alphabetically.
pairs.sql: SELECT T.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T INNER JOIN publisher AS P ON T.publisher_id = P.id INNER JOIN gender AS G ON T.gender_id = G.id WHERE P.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND G.gender = 'Female' ORDER BY T.superhero_name

pairs.name: fresh-003
pairs.question: Which superhero has the greatest number of superpowers?
pairs.sql: SELECT T.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T INNER JOIN hero_power AS H ON T.id = H.hero_id GROUP BY T.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

pairs.name: fresh-004
pairs.question: How many heroes have the power named Agility?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_power WHERE power_id = (SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name = 'Agility')

pairs.name: fresh-005
pairs.question: For each alignment, show the average weight in kilograms of the heroes that have one, from heaviest to lightest.
pairs.sql: SELECT A.alignment, AVG(T.weight_kg) FROM superhero AS T INNER JOIN alignment AS A ON T.alignment_id = A.id WHERE T.weight_kg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY A.alignment ORDER BY AVG(T.weight_kg) DESC

pairs.name: fresh-006
pairs.question: What is the publisher of the superhero named Abe Sapien?
pairs.sql: SELECT P.publisher_name FROM superhero AS T INNER JOIN publisher AS P ON T.publisher_id = P.id WHERE T.superhero_name = 'Abe Sapien'

pairs.name: fresh-007
pairs.question: List the superheroes whose eye colour is blue and whose race is Human.
pairs.sql: SELECT T.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T INNER JOIN colour AS C ON T.eye_colour_id = C.id INNER JOIN race AS R ON T.race_id = R.id WHERE C.colour = 'Blue' AND R.race = 'Human'

pairs.name: fresh-008
pairs.question: How many members are in the President position?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE position = 'President'

pairs.name: fresh-009
pairs.question: What is the total income amount received from sources other than dues?
pairs.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income WHERE source <> 'Dues'

pairs.name: fresh-010
pairs.question: List the email addresses of the members majoring in Human Development and Family Studies.
pairs.sql: SELECT T.email FROM member AS T INNER JOIN major AS M ON T.link_to_major = M.major_id WHERE M.major_name = 'Human Development and Family Studies'

pairs.name: fresh-011
pairs.question: How many events have the type Game?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE type = 'Game'

pairs.name: fresh-012
pairs.question: Show the names of the members who attended at least three events, along with their attendance counts.
pairs.sql: SELECT M.first_name, M.last_name, COUNT(*) FROM attendance AS A INNER JOIN member AS M ON A.link_to_member = M.member_id GROUP BY M.member_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

pairs.name: fresh-013
pairs.question: What is the total amount spent on the budget category Food?
pairs.sql: SELECT SUM(spent) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food'

pairs.name: fresh-014
pairs.question: Which city has the largest number of zip codes listed?
pairs.sql: SELECT city FROM zip_code GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

pairs.name: fresh-015
pairs.question: List the events that are still open and have no one attending them.
pairs.sql: SELECT event_name FROM event WHERE status = 'Open' AND event_id NOT IN (SELECT link_to_event FROM attendance)

pairs.name: fresh-016
pairs.question: How many molecules are labeled as carcinogenic?
pairs.evidence: A label of '+' means carcinogenic; '-' means not carcinogenic.
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'

pairs.name: fresh-017
pairs.question: How many atoms of the element cl are there?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element = 'cl'

pairs.name: fresh-018
pairs.question: How many double bonds are there?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '='

pairs.name: fresh-019
pairs.question: List the molecule identifiers of the molecules that contain an atom of the element n.
pairs.sql: SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'n'

pairs.name: fresh-020
pairs.question: What is the label of the molecule with identifier TR000?
pairs.sql: SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

pairs.name: fresh-021
pairs.question: Find the average number of oxygen atoms per molecule, over only the molecules that are carcinogenic.
pairs.sql: SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM atom AS A INNER JOIN molecule AS M ON A.molecule_id = M.molecule_id WHERE A.element = 'o' AND M.label = '+' GROUP BY A.molecule_id)

pairs.name: fresh-022
pairs.question: Which bond type appears most often in the database?
pairs.sql: SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

pairs.name: fresh-023
pairs.question: How many atoms are connected to more than one other atom?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT atom_id FROM connected GROUP BY atom_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

pairs.name: fresh-024
pairs.question: How many patients have been diagnosed with SLE?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

pairs.name: fresh-025
pairs.question: How many patients have the description 1994-02-14?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Description = '1994-02-14'

pairs.name: fresh-026
pairs.question: List the patient identifiers whose anti-nucleus antibody level is above 100.
pairs.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination WHERE ANA > 100

pairs.name: fresh-027
pairs.question: What is the highest GOT value recorded for the patient with ID 2927464?
pairs.sql: SELECT MAX(GOT) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 2927464

pairs.name: fresh-028
pairs.question: How many examinations recorded a thrombosis?
pairs.evidence: A thrombosis is recorded in the Thrombosis column as 1.
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 1

pairs.name: fresh-029
pairs.question: For each diagnosis, list the number of male patients, from most to fewest.
pairs.sql: SELECT Diagnosis, COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' GROUP BY Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

pairs.name: fresh-030
pairs.question: How many laboratory records are there for the patient with ID 2927464?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 2927464

pairs.name: fresh-031
pairs.question: Which patients have an ANA pattern of S?
pairs.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination WHERE "ANA Pattern" = 'S'

pairs.name: fresh-032
pairs.question: How many schools are in Los Angeles County?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Los Angeles'

pairs.name: fresh-033
pairs.question: What is the zip code of the school named Alameda High?
pairs.sql: SELECT Zip FROM schools WHERE School = 'Alameda High'

pairs.name: fresh-034
pairs.question: List the names of the schools in the city of Fresno that are charter schools.
pairs.sql: SELECT School FROM schools WHERE City = 'Fresno' AND Charter = 1

pairs.name: fresh-035
pairs.question: What is the average enrollment for K-12 in San Diego County?
pairs.sql: SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)`) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'San Diego'

pairs.name: fresh-036
pairs.question: Which district has the highest average number of students taking the SAT?
pairs.evidence: The number of students taking the SAT is the NumTstTakr column in satscores.
pairs.sql: SELECT dname FROM satscores GROUP BY dname ORDER BY AVG(NumTstTakr) DESC LIMIT 1

pairs.name: fresh-037
pairs.question: How many schools in the frpm table are of the educational option type Continuation School?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE "Educational Option Type" = 'Continuation School'

pairs.name: fresh-038
pairs.question: What is the lowest average reading score among the schools in Orange County?
pairs.sql: SELECT MIN(AvgScrRead) FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Orange'

pairs.name: fresh-039
pairs.question: List the schools that are virtual and have a magnet program.
pairs.sql: SELECT School FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'F' AND Magnet = 1

pairs.name: fresh-040
pairs.question: How many constructors are British?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM constructors WHERE nationality = 'British'

pairs.name: fresh-041
pairs.question: What is the nationality of the driver Lewis Hamilton?
pairs.sql: SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton'

pairs.name: fresh-042
pairs.question: How many races took place in the year 2008?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races WHERE year = 2008

pairs.name: fresh-043
pairs.question: Which circuit hosted the 2008 Monaco Grand Prix?
pairs.sql: SELECT C.name FROM races AS R INNER JOIN circuits AS C ON R.circuitId = C.circuitId WHERE R.year = 2008 AND R.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'

pairs.name: fresh-044
pairs.question: What is the fastest lap time recorded at the Circuit de Monaco, in milliseconds?
pairs.sql: SELECT MIN(L.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes AS L INNER JOIN races AS R ON L.raceId = R.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS C ON R.circuitId = C.circuitId WHERE C.name = 'Circuit de Monaco'

pairs.name: fresh-045
pairs.question: How many drivers were born in Finland?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Finnish'

pairs.name: fresh-046
pairs.question: List the names of the circuits located in Italy.
pairs.sql: SELECT name FROM circuits WHERE country = 'Italy'

pairs.name: fresh-047
pairs.question: Which driver has the most wins in total, according to the driver standings?
pairs.evidence: Total wins is the maximum of the wins column across a driver's standings rows.
pairs.sql: SELECT T.forename, T.surname FROM drivers AS T INNER JOIN (SELECT driverId, SUM(wins) AS w FROM driverStandings GROUP BY driverId ORDER BY w DESC LIMIT 1) AS S ON T.driverId = S.driverId

pairs.name: fresh-048
pairs.question: What is the average milliseconds duration of a pit stop?
pairs.sql: SELECT AVG(milliseconds) FROM pitStops

pairs.name: fresh-049
pairs.question: How many results have the status Finished?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results AS R INNER JOIN status AS S ON R.statusId = S.statusId WHERE S.status = 'Finished'

pairs.name: fresh-050
pairs.question: How many customers use the CZK currency?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Currency = 'CZK'

pairs.name: fresh-051
pairs.question: How many gas stations belong to chain 3?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE ChainID = 3

pairs.name: fresh-052
pairs.question: What is the total amount of the transactions made with the product named Service charge?
pairs.sql: SELECT SUM(Amount) FROM transactions_1k WHERE ProductID = (SELECT ProductID FROM products WHERE Description = 'Service charge')

pairs.name: fresh-053
pairs.question: How many customers are in the SME segment?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME'

pairs.name: fresh-054
pairs.question: What is the highest consumption recorded in the yearmonth table?
pairs.sql: SELECT MAX(Consumption) FROM yearmonth

pairs.name: fresh-055
pairs.question: For each segment, list the number of gas stations whose country is CZE.
pairs.sql: SELECT Segment, COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'CZE' GROUP BY Segment

pairs.name: fresh-056
pairs.question: How many transactions were made at gas station 1?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k WHERE GasStationID = 1

pairs.name: fresh-057
pairs.question: Which customer has the largest total consumption, and what is that total?
pairs.sql: SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) FROM yearmonth GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1
